headline: Botswana Increases 2026 Economic Growth Forecast to 3.8%
summary: Botswana has raised its 2026 economic growth forecast to 3.8% from 3.1%, citing a rebound in diamond production and recovering US demand for natural stones.
why: Botswana's economy is heavily dependent on the diamond industry, making it vulnerable to global luxury market trends and commodity demand.

impacts.name: Botswana
impacts.why: Improved economic outlook based on export demand.
